new_findings.title: Per-item run stamps can contradict top-level provenance
new_findings.defect: When a successful item's describe object contains a run-configuration stamp, _model_provenance uses it without checking a value for the same key in run_provenance. score_run_record later spreads the original run provenance and also adds the model summary, so the same score can publish conflicting values.
new_findings.failure_scenario: The run record has provenance.seed=17 and two successful items each have describe.seed=42. Scoring succeeds and emits provenance.seed as 17 while provenance.model.seeds is [42], misidentifying the treatment used for the captions.
new_findings.fix: When a run-level stamp is present, compare its canonical value with the homogeneous item-level value and raise ReportError on disagreement; add a regression test for a conflicting seed (and exercise another stamp dimension if the check is shared).

summary: One open finding is now fixed and two prior fixes hold. The lane suite passed with 93 passed and 1 skipped; integration review found one medium before-merge provenance mismatch when item and run-level stamps disagree.
